entries.summary: 1353, die 27 februarii, Ecclesia herbipolensis de possessionum et redditum episcopatus venditione et obligatione, conditione reemtionis adjecta, statuit
entries.latin:
Jn nomine domini amen.
Nos Heinricus decanus totumque capitulum ecclesie herbi-
polensis profitemur publice in hiis scriptis, quod nos grauibus et
irrecuperabilibus dampnis et periculis nobis et ecclesie nostre in-
minentibus pro recuperandis feudis ac bonis feudalibus et aliis ex
morte quondam domine Juthe de Hennenberg seu alias ecclesie
nostre vacantibus, que prochdolor in parte a magnatibus et a po-
tentibus .. principibus occupata dinoscuntur, et residua a predictis occu-
pari verisimiliter inantea formidantur, auxilio dei mediante succur-
rere cupientes, vnanimi voluntate ob hoc in capitulo nostro capitu-
lariter congregati, tractatibus pluribus et matura deliberacione pre-
habitis, sub modis et condicionibus infrascriptis consensimus et pre-
sentibus consentimus, quod reuerendus in Cristo pater dominus noster
dominus Albertus episcopus ecclesie nostre herbipolensis
pro stipendiis militaribus expensis et aliis necessariis habendis et
distribuendis in gwerris huiusmodi castra municiones officia juris-
dictiones villas redditus aut alia bona inmobilia ipsius episcopatus
herbipolensis possit obligare seu vendere ad tempora vite con-
trahencium .. personarum seu alia certa tempora aut alias, sub gracia
tamen et potestate ipsa redimendi quandocunque ac reemendi, vsque
ad summam decem milium librarum hallensium, personis quibus-
cunque et specialiter fratribus capitularibus ecclesie nostre predicte,
si qui sint qui huiusmodi contractus eo modo et forma quibus alij
facere voluerint et consumare, quos aliis dominus noster episcopus
predictus in premissis requirendo in toto vel in parte anteferre de-
bebit, jta tamen quod sigillum capituli nostri litteris contractuum
huiusmodi non apponatur donec peccunie obligacionum et vendi-
cionum huiusmodi per contrahentes presentande ad sacristiam et
cameram ecclesie nostre herbipolensis seu alibi vbi ipsis septem
personis iamsubscriptis vel maiori parti tunc presencium ex eisdem
videbitur expedire conseruande in presencia septem personarum ea-
rundem seu maioris partis ipsarum vt predicitur reponantur et pre-
sententur.
Nec ad alios vsus distribuantur nisi pro recuperandis feudis et
bonis supradictis, et de scitu et beneplacito vnanimi honorabilium
virorum domini decani predicti, Gotfridi de Nydecke, Johanis
Pincerne de Erpach, Johanis de Grumbach, archidiaconorum,
Johanis de Rosenberg, Engelhardi de Bebenburk,
Ernesti de Rysthenhusen, canonicorum herbipolensium,
quos ad hoc de nostrum omnium beneplacito et consensu duximus
deputandos ac per presentes deputamus, jta tamen quod si aliquem
seu aliquos ex eis cedere vel decedere contigerit quod tunc .. super-
stites vel maior pars ex eisdem habeant alium vel alios in locum
eorundem subrogare.
Et si deo concedente discordiis et gwerris predictis cessantibus
aut sopitis predictus vsus aut necessitas stipendiorum cessabit, dicta
peccunia in toto, si tota, vel in parte, si pars fuerit, jn redemp-
ciones et reempciones bonorum episcopatus sic obligatorum seu
venditorum dari debebunt et conuerti, seu alias vbi dominis nostris
predictis melius expedire videbitur, contradictione cuiuscunque
semota.
Adiectum est eciam, quod si contingat dictas gwerras et dis-
cordias terminari vel sopiri, aut eciam quomodolibet prorogari, et
medio tempore vel postmodum precariam generalem wlgariter dictam
lantbeto obtineri, quod primo et ante omnia de huiusmodi pre-
caria castra municiones jurisdictiones ville redditus et bona alia
inmobilia dicti episcopatus obligata vel vendita vt prefertur absque
contradictione cuiuslibet vtique redimi ac reemi debeant et liberari.
Jn premissorum testimonium nos decanus et capitulum predicti
presens jnstrumentum desuper confectum nostri capituli sigillo feci-
mus sigillari.
Jnsuper nos Albertus dei gracia episcopus herbipolensis
predictus presentibus nos firmiter obligamus, nos inantea bona ec-
clesie nostre inmobilia non vendere non inpignorare nec obligare
neque alias alienare cuiquam consensu nostri capituli irrequisito nec
habito super eo. Recongnoscimus quoque, supradicta omnia prout
narrantur esse vera et sic acta et gesta. Et ad eorundem omnium
et singulorum obseruanciam nos obligamus fideliter in hiis scriptis,
nostri sigilli appensione roboratis jn euidenciam premissorum.
Datum Herbipoli, anno dominj M° CCC° L tercio, feria quarta
ante dominicam oculi proximam.
entries.english:
In the name of the Lord, amen. We, Heinrich, dean, and the whole chapter of the church of Würzburg publicly declare in this writing that, since grave and irrecoverable damage and dangers threaten us and our church, in order to recover the fiefs and feudal goods and other property which have fallen vacant to our church through the death of the late Lady Jutta von Henneberg or otherwise, and which, alas, are known to be partly occupied by magnates and powerful princes, while the remainder is likely to be seized by the aforesaid in future, desiring to help with God's aid, we have gathered in chapter with unanimous will and, after much discussion and mature deliberation, have consented and do consent by these presents, under the modes and conditions written below, that the reverend father in Christ, our lord Lord Albert, bishop of our church of Würzburg, may, in order to have and distribute military pay, expenses and other necessities in such wars, pledge or sell castles, fortifications, offices, jurisdictions, villages, rents or other immovable goods of the diocese of Würzburg for the lifetimes of the contracting persons or other fixed periods or otherwise, but with the grace and power of redeeming and buying them back at any time, up to the sum of ten thousand pounds of Haller, to any persons and especially to the chapter brethren of our aforesaid church, if there are any who wish to make and conclude such contracts in the manner and form in which others would, whom our lord the bishop shall, on asking in the matter, prefer before others in whole or in part, but so that the seal of our chapter is not affixed to letters of such contracts until the money of such pledges and sales has been presented by the contracting parties to the sacristy and treasury of our church of Würzburg or elsewhere where it seems expedient to the seven persons named below or to the majority of those then present of them, and is deposited and presented in the presence of the seven persons or the majority of them, as stated.
Nor shall it be distributed for other uses except for recovering the aforesaid fiefs and goods, and with the knowledge and unanimous approval of the honourable men, the lord dean aforesaid, Gotfried von Niedeck, Johann Schenk von Erbach, Hans von Grumbach, archdeacons, Hans von Rosenberg, Engelhard von Bebenburg, Ernst von Rysthenhusen, canons of Würzburg, whom we have thought fit to depute for this with the approval and consent of us all, and do depute by these presents; so, however, that if one or more of them should resign or die, the survivors or the majority of them may appoint another or others in their place.
And if, God willing, the said discords and wars cease or are settled and the use or need for pay ceases, the said money, in whole if all, or in part if only part, shall be given and applied to the redemption and repurchase of the goods of the diocese thus pledged or sold, or otherwise where it seems better to our aforesaid lords, any objection set aside.
It has also been added that if the said wars and discords are ended or settled, or also prolonged in any way, and in the meantime or afterwards a general levy, commonly called "lantbeto", is obtained, then first and before all else the castles, fortifications, jurisdictions, villages, rents and other immovable goods of the said diocese pledged or sold as stated shall be redeemed and bought back and freed from such levy without anyone's objection.
In testimony of the foregoing we, the dean and chapter aforesaid, have had this instrument drawn up about it sealed with our chapter's seal.
Moreover we, Albert, by the grace of God bishop of Würzburg aforesaid, firmly bind ourselves by these presents not to sell, pledge, obligate or otherwise alienate the immovable goods of our church to anyone from now on without asking and obtaining the consent of our chapter on it. We also acknowledge that all the aforesaid are true as narrated and thus done and enacted. And for the observance of each and all of these we bind ourselves faithfully in this writing, strengthened by the appending of our seal as evidence of the foregoing.
Given at Würzburg, in the year of the Lord 1353, on the Wednesday before the next Sunday Oculi.

facts.content: issued the chapter's consent for the bishop to sell or pledge property of the diocese of Würzburg, and sealed it with the chapter's seal.
was permitted by the cathedral chapter to pledge or sell property of the diocese of Würzburg, and bound himself not to alienate immovable goods without the chapter's consent.
was one of the seven persons deputed to receive and keep the money from pledges and sales of diocesan property and to apply it to recovering fiefs and goods of the church of Würzburg.
